pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches are dark brown polygons with high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Geometries are larger and more elongated on the neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented, and irregular shapes on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored corridors form a continuous tessellated network with visible trifurcated and quadrifurcated junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the torso, maintaining a high level of connectivity without significant pixel blurring.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. Individual hair bundles create a jagged 1D contour against the sky, appearing as a dark, consistent linear feature.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct dark avian organisms (oxpeckers) are visible: one perched on the dorsal ridge near the shoulder and another on the lateral aspect of the neck.
